decision.explanation: Q01 is broadly most similar to C06 (bowed_rotor): an approximately 2× frequency shift maps the principal and several secondary lines especially well while preserving strong periodicity and harmonic/modulation organization. C03 is also broadly similar after the same shift, but C06 has the better multi-line correspondence, notably near 60, 90, 108, 180 and 210 Hz in Q01. Fixed-band powers differ mainly because the shift moves components above 100 Hz, while startup evolution and unknown gain remain qualifications.
